title: Deck Plan
description: Deck-level outline produced from the brief. Adaptive in length and structure: the planner chooses how many slides, what sections, which layouts, and per-slide density. Per-slide detail lives in slide_plan.json files. Schema enforces source traceability and the section/slide cross-references; it does NOT impose a maximum slide count or a required layout sequence.

template.description: Name of the template under templates/layouts/, e.g. 'business_review'.

theme_overrides.description: TODO: enumerate overridable theme tokens once the design system stabilizes.

planning.description: Adaptive planning record. Validators cross-check planned_slide_count against len(slides).

planned_slide_count.description: Integer the planner committed to. Validators require this to equal len(slides).

rationale.description: Short explanation of why this length and section structure suits the brief. No raw sensitive source text.

sections.description: Ordered section list. Validators require sections[].slide_indices to cover every deck_plan slide exactly once, with no duplicates, missing, or orphan indices.

id.description: Stable section identifier referenced by slides[].section_id.

summary.description: Short qualitative description of what the section covers.

slide_indices.description: 1-based slide indices contained by this section. Validators require these to match the slides[].index values that carry the matching section_id.

layout.description: Must match a layout name in the chosen template.

section_id.description: References sections[].id. Validators require this id to exist and the slide's index to be listed in that section's slide_indices.

summary.description: Short qualitative description of this slide. No raw sensitive source text.

density.description: Planner's density hint for this slide. Small enum on purpose; tighten only when the design system needs more granularity.

source_refs.description: Opaque source identifiers this slide draws from. Validators require every value to be declared in deck_brief.source_refs.
